Calcarea Chlorinata.



Chlorinated Lime. CaOCl 2 . Hypochlorate of lime with
        Chloride of Calcium and a varying amount of Hydrate of Lime.



Clinical. ─   Boils.   Carbuncles  .



Characteristics. ─   This preparation has only been
        used as a local application, for boils and carbuncles chiefly, in the form of the   Liquor Calcis Chloratæ   of the British Pharmacopœia.
